import sys,time,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as M
random.seed(11)
for natoms in [2,3,4]:
  toks=['a','b']
  rules=[]
  for i in range(natoms):
    p=[random.choice(toks) for _ in range(16)]
    rules.append({'action':'allow','when':{'op':'contains','path':p}})
  req={'services':toks,'rules':rules,'queries':[[]]}
  t=time.time()
  try:
    res=M.compile_bundle(req)
    print("contains natoms",natoms,"states",len(res['dfa']['accept']),"time",round(time.time()-t,3))
  except M.WireError as e:
    print("contains natoms",natoms,"ERR",e.code,"time",round(time.time()-t,3))
